B11.name: portable-slot-plate
B11.summary: B06 made portable: same closed slots, no wall posts, rounded all over; hangs from both end slots.
B11.hang: End slots: two hooks, two screws with washers, or a sling through both

B12.name: two-row-slot-plate
B12.summary: Two rows of closed slots: 7 below for quickdraws, 6 above whose carabiners hang down through a long window, so the rows never tangle.
B12.hang: End slots: two hooks, two screws with washers, or a sling through both

B13.name: carry-handle-bar
B13.summary: Slot plate with a hand-grip cut-out on top: carry your whole sport rack to the crag like a toolbox.

B14.name: pocket-bar

B14.hang: End slots: two hooks, two screws with washers, or a sling through both

B15.name: bar-helmet-loop
B15.summary: Five closed slots plus a big closed helmet loop at the end: rack and helmet on one bar.

B15.hang: Left end slot plus the helmet loop's top bar

B16.name: box-ladder
B16.summary: Ladder of square boxes between two rails: lighter than the plate, same closed openings.

B17.name: arc-bar
B17.summary: Curved slot plate: carabiners fan out instead of bunching, and it sits nicely against a pack or a post.

B18.name: ultralight-plate

B19.name: angled-slot-plate
B19.summary: Six slots tilted 30 degrees so clipped pieces hang staggered and don't clash.

B20.name: gear-board

R11.name: full-loop-ring

R15.summary: Two rows of closed windows: 13 on the outside for cams, 7 on the inside for nuts and draws.
